jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description: Role summary Bluerock TMS builds the autonomous orchestration platform that keeps global logistics moving — orchestrating complex, multi-modal transport networks for customers across fashion, food & beverage, manufacturing, healthcare, and more. Real complexity, at real scale, every single day. We're looking for a Product Manager who has actually lived inside logistics or TMS operations. Someone who can understand operations complexity and who is willing to take on this challenge and contribute hands on to build the next level of TMS. You'll own the products that turn that complexity into clarity, working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, sales, and implementation to make sure what we build actually gets adopted. Responsibilities Product vision, grounded in real user needs You dig past what customers ask for to find the problem underneath, and turn that into a direction for your area the company can rally behind. Market scoping and opportunity-spotting Scanning the logistics landscape, competitor moves, and customer signals to find where Bluerock should build next, not just what's already on the backlog. Logistics know-how turned into product decisions   Planning, transport execution, freight, last-mile — decisions that hold up against how operations actually run, not just how they're described to you. The full lifecycle From first idea to adoption. You don't hand off and disappear. The connective tissue across the company   When priorities compete or a customer escalation needs an answer fast, you're the one pulling the threads together. The team you’ll join You'll join an international product team with complementary skills and a shared passion for a good challenge, real, hands-on experience in logistics paired with genuine enthusiasm for technology. We don't settle for quick patches: we strive for quality, look for the sustainable solution over the easy one, and keep an eye on what next-level TMS should look like, not just what's in front of us today. Life at Bluerock We're a distributed team across the Netherlands, Italy, the US, and Canada that operates like one crew: local insight, global perspective. We're curious by default, self-driven without needing to be told twice, and genuinely joyful about solving hard logistics problems together. We're team-minded because the best answers rarely come from one person alone, and unapologetically reliable because our customers' supply chains don't get a “we'll fix it next sprint.” As one of us put it: at the end of the day, it's the people that make Bluerock. 5+ years in product or project management within logistics, supply chain, or TMS — hands-on TMS experience is required. Bachelor's degree in Project Management, Business Administration, Information Systems, Supply Chain/Logistics, or a related field  required. jobs.title: Senior Recruiter
jobs.description: Wij zoeken geen recruiter die wacht op sollicitaties. adesso Nederland groeit. En de mensen die wij zoeken, zijn meestal niet actief op zoek naar een nieuwe baan. Daarom zoeken we een Senior Recruiter die recruitment écht beheerst. Iemand die begrijpt dat een vacature online zetten het begin is en niet de strategie. Je weet hoe je zelf de markt in gaat. Je searcht, sourcet, benadert en bouwt relaties op. Je probeert verschillende invalshoeken als een search niet werkt. Je kent LinkedIn Recruiter, maar weet ook dat sourcing meer is dan een paar zoektermen invoeren en InMails versturen. En misschien nog belangrijker: je hebt ideeën. Over waar we talent kunnen vinden. Over hoe we mensen kunnen benaderen. Over employer branding. Over onze propositie als werkgever. Over tooling, data, events, referrals, communities en alles wat ons kan helpen om betere mensen aan adesso te verbinden. Zie je een kans? Dan verwachten we niet dat je wacht tot iemand je vertelt wat je moet doen. Je pakt hem. Wat ga je doen? Je krijgt verantwoordelijkheid voor recruitment binnen adesso Nederland en werkt nauw samen met hiring managers en management. Daarbij ben je zowel strategisch als operationeel. Want senior zijn betekent bij ons niet dat je alleen adviseert. Je doet het ook zelf. Je: voert zelfstandig searches uit naar schaarse IT-professionals; bouwt talentpools op in plaats van pas te zoeken zodra er een vacature ontstaat; benadert kandidaten persoonlijk en weet hun interesse te wekken; experimenteert met nieuwe sourcingkanalen en manieren van benaderen; voert intakes met hiring managers en durft kritisch te zijn op het profiel dat zij zoeken; adviseert over haalbaarheid, arbeidsmarkt, salaris en recruitmentstrategie; voert gesprekken met kandidaten en begeleidt het proces van eerste contact tot hire; houdt overzicht over je vacatures en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor het resultaat; gebruikt data om te begrijpen wat wel en niet werkt; komt zelf met voorstellen om recruitment slimmer en effectiever te maken; denkt mee over employer branding, referral recruitment, events en communities; bouwt mee aan hoe recruitment binnen adesso Nederland zich verder ontwikkelt. Je krijgt daarbij geen dichtgetimmerd recruitmenthandboek. We verwachten juist dat jij vanuit je ervaring kunt zeggen: “Dit werkt niet. Ik denk dat we het zo moeten aanpakken.” En vervolgens help je om het te realiseren. Wanneer ben je voor ons senior? Niet omdat er ‘Senior Recruiter’ op je LinkedIn-profiel staat. Voor ons zit senioriteit in hoe je werkt. Je hoeft niet gevraagd te worden om te sourcen je weet dat het onderdeel van je vak is. Als een search niets oplevert, concludeer je niet dat “de markt lastig is”. Je verandert je aanpak. Als een hiring manager een onrealistisch profiel zoekt, durf je dat gesprek te voeren. Als je ziet dat ons recruitmentproces beter kan, kom je niet alleen met het probleem maar ook met een voorstel. En als je een goed idee hebt, krijg je energie van het daadwerkelijk uitvoeren ervan. We zoeken iemand met stevige recruitmentervaring, bij voorkeur binnen IT, tech of consultancy. Maar het aantal jaren ervaring vinden we minder belangrijk dan wat je daadwerkelijk kunt. We willen vooral zien dat je: aantoonbaar sterk bent in search, sourcing en direct benaderen; weet hoe je schaarse senior professionals vindt en interesseert; verschillende sourcingstrategieën kunt bedenken én uitvoeren; creatief bent in het vinden van nieuwe kandidaten en doelgroepen; verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor je vacatures en resultaten; zelfstandig prioriteiten stelt; hiring managers als volwaardig gesprekspartner adviseert; kritisch durft te zijn wanneer dat nodig is; nieuwsgierig bent naar nieuwe recruitmenttechnieken, tooling en AI; met data naar je eigen recruitmentfunnel kijkt; ideeën niet alleen bedenkt, maar ook uitvoert; Nederlands en Engels professioneel beheerst. jobs.title: Data Management consultant
jobs.description: Wij zijn op zoek naar een dynamische en veelzijdige Data Consultant om ons team te versterken. De ideale kandidaat beschikt over een unieke combinatie van consultancyvaardigheden, projectmanagementexpertise en een verkoopgerichte mentaliteit, samen met een diepgaand begrip van datamanagement en datastrategieprincipes. Deze rol vereist een individu die zich moeiteloos kan aanpassen aan diverse projecten en klantbehoeften, en zakelijke successen kan stimuleren door middel van effectieve datastrategieën. Als Data & Strategy Consultant bij adesso speel je een cruciale rol in het helpen van onze klanten om het volledige potentieel van hun data te benutten. Deze functie vraagt om een professional die niet alleen de fijne kneepjes van datamanagement begrijpt, maar ook uitblinkt in projectmanagement en business development. Jouw primaire verantwoordelijkheid zal zijn om de kloof te overbruggen tussen technische data-oplossingen en zakelijke doelstellingen, zodat onze klanten weloverwogen, data-gedreven beslissingen kunnen nemen. Sterke klantrelaties opbouwen en onderhouden om nieuwe zakelijke kansen te identificeren en te benutten. Coördineren met multifunctionele teams, waaronder data-ingenieurs, analisten en andere consultants, om uitgebreide data-oplossingen te leveren. Beoordelingen uitvoeren van bestaande datamanagementprocessen en verbeteringen aanbevelen. Op de hoogte blijven van trends en ontwikkelingen in de sector om de dienstverlening voortdurend te verbeteren. Overtuigende presentaties en voorstellen voorbereiden en leveren om nieuwe klanten te werven. Samenwerken met het verkoopteam om verkoopstrategieën te ontwikkelen en uit te voeren die aansluiten bij de bedrijfsdoelstellingen. Een continue leermentaliteit omarmen om effectief in te spelen op evoluerende zakelijke uitdagingen. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Bouw dataplatformen die klaar zijn voor wat er morgen met data en AI gebeurt. Bij adesso zoeken we een Data Engineer die verder kijkt dan alleen het bouwen van pipelines. Iemand die nadenkt over hoe data wordt verzameld, gemodelleerd, ontsloten en gebruikt en die graag werkt aan moderne data-oplossingen binnen Microsoft Azure en Snowflake. Je werkt aan dataplatformen die organisaties daadwerkelijk gebruiken. Als basis voor reporting en analytics, maar steeds vaker ook voor machine learning, AI en agentic toepassingen. Jouw rol Als Data Engineer ontwerp en bouw je schaalbare data-oplossingen voor onze klanten. Je werkt aan het hele traject: van databron en architectuur tot een betrouwbaar platform waarop data daadwerkelijk gebruikt kan worden. Daarbij werk je voornamelijk binnen het Azure-ecosysteem en denk je mee over keuzes rondom architectuur, datamodellering, performance en schaalbaarheid. Je bent niet alleen degene die bouwt. Je begrijpt waarom bepaalde keuzes worden gemaakt, kunt hierover sparren met klanten en collega's en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor de kwaliteit van de oplossing. Wat ga je doen? ·       Ontwerpen, bouwen en onderhouden van schaalbare data pipelines en dataplatformen; ·       Ontwikkelen van cloud-native data-oplossingen; ·       Integreren, transformeren en ontsluiten van data uit verschillende bronnen; ·       Ontwerpen en implementeren van moderne Data Warehouse- en Lakehouse-architecturen; ·       Toepassen van datamodelleringsmethodieken zoals Kimball en Data Vault; ·       Bouwen van betrouwbare datasets voor analytics, dashboards, machine learning en AI-toepassingen; ·       Werken met technologieën zoals Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory en Snowflake; ·       Optimaliseren van performance, schaalbaarheid, betrouwbaarheid en datakwaliteit; ·       Inrichten en verbeteren van CI/CD-processen en toepassen van DataOps-principes; ·       Meedenken met klanten over data-architectuur, integraties en technische keuzes; ·       Samenwerken met Data Scientists, AI Engineers, Data Architects en andere specialisten binnen ons Data & AI-team. We zoeken niet iemand die ieder vinkje op een technologielijst kan zetten. We zoeken vooral een Data Engineer die een stevig technisch fundament heeft, nieuwsgierig blijft en verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor wat hij of zij bouwt. Je hebt: ·       Minimaal 4 jaar relevante ervaring als Data Engineer of in een vergelijkbare rol; ·       Sterke kennis van SQL en Python; ·       Ervaring met het ontwerpen en bouwen van ETL/ELT-processen en data pipelines; ·       Ervaring met Microsoft Azure en relevante Azure-datadiensten, zoals Databricks, Fabric, Snowflake; ·       Ervaring met datamodellering en moderne data-architecturen, bijvoorbeeld Kimball en Data Vault; ·       Kennis van Data Warehouse- en/of Lakehouse-concepten; ·       Ervaring met CI/CD, DevOps en bij voorkeur Infrastructure as Code; ·       Oog voor datakwaliteit, performance, schaalbaarheid en onderhoudbaarheid; ·       Het vermogen om technische keuzes uit te leggen en hierover met klanten en collega's te sparren; ·       Een uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal. Mooi meegenomen Heb je daarnaast ervaring met een aantal van onderstaande technologieën of onderwerpen? Mooi. Maar we verwachten niet dat je alles al hebt gedaan. ·

jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Tenstorrent is leading the industry on cutting-edge AI technology, revolutionizing performance expectations, ease of use, and cost efficiency. With AI redefining the computing paradigm, solutions must evolve to unify innovations in software models, compilers, platforms, networking, and semiconductors. Our diverse team of technologists have developed a high performance RISC-V CPU from scratch, and share a passion for AI and a deep desire to build the best AI platform possible. We value collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to solving hard problems. We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities.</p></div><p>The Architecture team at Tenstorrent is designing the central compute chiplet that powers our next generation automotive SoC. This role is about turning real world automotive and safety requirements into architecture that performs, scales, and ships fast and reliably. If you think silicon design should start with clarity and end with confidence, this is where your experience makes the biggest impact.</p> <p><em>This role is remote, based in Munich, Germany.</em></p> <p><em>We welcome candidates at various experience levels for this role. jobs.title: Head of Product Compliance (f/m/d)
jobs.description: We see the potential inside everything and everyone. Starting with you. Orbem uses AI to industrialize MRI, delivering non-invasive insight into everything from fruits to eggs to the human body. We are transforming what is becoming the world's largest biological dataset into actionable intelligence to reduce waste, increase quality, and accelerate the shift toward a more sustainable and healthier future. Headquartered and founded in Munich, Germany, with an office now in Houston, Texas, our world-class team is scaling inside-out technology to transform how humanity sees and understands biological matter. Help us see what's possible. Join us. Your Role Reporting directly to the Senior Director of Product, you will drive product quality management and regulatory compliance for Orbem’s cutting-edge systems across the EU, US, and other upcoming markets. You will serve as the strategic bridge connecting complex hardware, software, and AI capabilities with international safety and industry standards. Leading and scaling the product compliance team, you will ensure our products meet global market standards and internal quality requirements fast. Your Day-to-Day Enable Global Product Impact: Own compliance roadmaps for international market access, securing NRTL approvals and achieving CE marking through the Machinery Regulation and EMC Directive. Lead and Scale the Team: Mentor and grow the product compliance team, fostering a culture of continuous learning, fast delivery, and strong ownership. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with product development disciplines, Field Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Legal experts to embed compliance and quality management seamlessly into our product lifecycle. Close the Conformity Loop: Own the path from field and production nonconformances through root-cause analysis and CAPA into updated risk assessments, technical files, and design changes — so what we learn on site changes what we build. Stakeholder Enablement: Translate complex regulatory frameworks into clear guidance, facilitating alignment and smooth execution across multidisciplinary teams. Agile Framework Optimization: Maintain structured compliance guidelines while adapting processes to support the fluid pace of a fast-growing scaleup environment. Champion system validation processes to ensure product reliability. Own Regulated Product Documentation: Take accountability for operator, installation, and maintenance manuals, safety markings, and translations as conformity deliverables in their own right, leading the technical writers who produce them. Your Experience and Skills You have 10 + years experience in compliance and quality management and proven experience in a leadership role, ideally within an agile scale-up or high-growth tech environment. Experience overseeing complex systems that combine hardware, software, and AI, ideally involving special machinery or automation equipment. You have run nonconformance and CAPA processes for complex electromechanical products, with hands-on root-cause practice (8D, FMEA, fault tree or equivalent) and a track record of field failures actually changing designs. Broad knowledge of international product compliance frameworks, specifically UL508A and NFPA79 approvals, and CE marking under the Machinery Regulation and EMC Directive. You have defined quality and compliance requirements in stage-gate processes, and built Design for Compliance, and Design for Quality principles in the product development process. Track record of building, mentoring, and scaling technical teams. Strong cross-functional communication and stakeholder management skills with a collaborative leadership mindset. You are comfortable defining a common framework for acceptance criteria and verification evidence, including factory and site acceptance testing, calibration, and measurement traceability. What Makes You Stand Out Direct domain experience with industrial automation systems in the food process

jobs.description: About finmid finmid is a platform enabling software businesses to grow their revenue by embedding financial services in their product through a single integration. By productizing the complexity of financial services, finmid empowers companies to offer financial services where FinTech isn't the mission, but enables the mission. More about who we are and what we do here . About the opportunity As a Strategy & Operations Intern at finmid, you’ll play a pivotal role in optimizing operational processes and supporting our revenue-driving efforts. Collaborating with cross-functional teams, you will tackle operational challenges, improve internal workflows, and contribute to projects that shape our customer experience and accelerate finmid's growth. This internship intends to equip you with the skills necessary for a successful full-time role at finmid, and we will extend job offers to return full-time for the best performers. In this role, you will: Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Product, Risk) to resolve customer issues and ensure a seamless customer experience. We also value experience operating distributed systems and data-intensive systems in the cloud, including multi-tenant environments and the scaling and security challenges they bring, databases, and durable execution runtimes. jobs.title: Senior ML Engineer | Kimchi (Inference Stack Optimization)
jobs.description: <h4>Why Kimchi?</h4> <p>Great models are raw ingredients. Kimchi is what happens when you ferment them with good engineering. We started inside CAST AI helping companies run LLMs on their own Kubernetes clusters; today we run our own coding harness on any model you pick, and we run the models underneath it ourselves.<br><br><strong>Kimchi Inference</strong></p> <p>One API line and a customer's existing client just works: DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, MiniMax, Nemotron served serverless from our own GPU fleet (OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible, pay per token, spend visible per user, team, and key). When control matters, the same models run on the customer's own cluster instead. Behind that one line sits the machinery you'll own: SGLang and vLLM engines, B300 nodes, a shared cluster filesystem that holds every checkpoint exactly once, KV caches riding coding traffic with heavy prefix reuse, and the benchmark harness that gates every change we ship.<br><br></p> <p><em data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="em"><span id="edb2bdea-40e7-48f0-9485-a0bd7169c7c7" data-mark-type="annotation" data-mark-annotation-type="inlineComment" data-id="edb2bdea-40e7-48f0-9485-a0bd7169c7c7" data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="annotation">Made by Cast AI — a Miami-headquartered, globally distributed team across 34 countries that hit unicorn status in January 2026 with a $50B+ backed investment pushing its valuation past $1 billion.</span></em></p> <h4>About the role</h4> <p>Throughput. Latency. Cold starts. Cost per token.</p> <p>Move those four numbers in the right direction and two things happen: customers get faster, cheaper inference, and our margins improve. That's the entire thesis of this role. Every loader you tune, every scheduler decision you land, every kernel you stare at shows up in a customer's p99 and on our P&amp;L. Your mandate is the inference stack's optimization, whatever it takes, and the technical direction of how we optimize it is yours to argue with data.</p> <p><strong>The problem:</strong> the checkpoints run 0.3-1.5 TB, and the "right" serving configuration depends on traffic shape, sequence-length distribution, batch dynamics, GPU SKU, memory bandwidth, and quantization tolerance, all variables that shift week to week. Most teams pick a configuration once, over-provision GPUs, and absorb the cost. We don't: we took Kimi-K3 (1.5 TB) from over an hour cold-to-serving to under twelve minutes with a shared filesystem, O_DIRECT weight loaders, and node-local JIT caches, and we're nowhere near done. The Auto Router makes the call: for every request, which model serves it. Eight open-source models whose input prices span more than 20×, cached input up to 50× cheaper than fresh, frontier providers on customers' own keys, and a coding agent that fires hundreds of requests before its task is done. jobs.description: About us Fashion Revolution Germany e.V. is the German chapter of Fashion Revolution, the global movement for a clean, safe, fair, transparent and accountable fashion industry. Since the Rana Plaza factory collapse in 2013, the movement has asked one question: Who made my clothes? As a non-profit association of designers, educators, communicators and activists, we run campaigns, workshops and events that make fashion’s social and environmental impacts visible and show practical alternatives such as repair, upcycling and circular models. The project: RE/CLAIMED at Berlin Fashion Week A key focus of this internship is RE/CLAIMED, a multidisciplinary sustainable fashion show supported by Fashion Revolution Germany. RE/CLAIMED combines upcycled runway looks, dance, live performance, music and interactive installations to change how people value their clothes. After a sold-out first edition in January 2026, the second edition will take place with around 400 guests expected. Your role You’ll pilot the day-to-day social media activities for RE/CLAIMED in the run-up to Berlin Fashion Week, during the show and in the follow-up. You’ll also support the coordination of the show and of Fashion Revolution Germany’s projects in Berlin. You’ll work directly with Eric Vincent Vinsonneau, who leads RE/CLAIMED, and alongside our communications partners. Beyond RE/CLAIMED, you’ll take part in other Fashion Revolution Germany activities in Berlin. One example is our stand at the Alt-Rixdorfer Christmas Market in Neukölln on the weekend of 4–6 December 2026, where you’ll help with preparation, on-site support and social media coverage. Your tasks Social media (main focus) Plan and manage the content calendar for RE/CLAIMED’s Instagram, and optionally build a TikTok presence Create posts, stories and reels: behind the scenes, designer and performer portraits, countdowns and impact facts Cover the show live and produce recap content afterwards Engage with the community, partners, designers and press, and track performance Project coordination Support show preparation: partners, designers, models, dancers, volunteers and schedules Help with on-site logistics on the show day Support other Fashion Revolution Germany projects in Berlin as needed Your profile You have a strong interest in sustainable fashion and social or environmental topics You have experience creating social media content, ideally including short-form video You have a good eye for aesthetics and storytelling You’re organised, reliable and proactive, and comfortable working independently in a small team You speak fluent English (our working language). jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p class="ms-outlook-mobile-reference-message skipProofing"><strong>About WPP Production</strong></p> <p class="ms-outlook-mobile-reference-message skipProofing">We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.</p> <p><strong>About WPP</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. jobs.title: Partner Success Manager, EMEA
jobs.description: Ironclad is the leading AI contracting platform that transforms agreements into assets. Contracts move faster, insights surface instantly, and agents push work forward, all with you in control. Whether you’re buying or selling, Ironclad unifies the entire process on one intelligent platform, providing leaders with the visibility they need to stay one step ahead. That’s why the world’s most transformative organizations, from Rivian to the World Health Organization and the Associated Press, trust Ironclad to accelerate their business. We’re consistently recognized as a leader in the industry: a Leader in the Forrester Wave and Gartner Magic Quadrant for Contract Lifecycle Management, a Fortune Great Place to Work, and one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Workplaces. Ironclad has also been named to Forbes’ AI 50 and Business Insider’s list of Companies to Bet Your Career On. We’re backed by leading investors including Accel, Y Combinator, Sequoia, BOND, and Franklin Templeton. For more information, visit www.ironcladapp.com or follow us on LinkedIn. This is a hybrid role. Office attendance is expected two days per week on Tuesdays and Thursdays in London. There may be additional in-office days for team or company events. Ironclad is scaling rapidly across EMEA through a partner-first go-to-market model. We’re looking for an entrepreneurial, proactive EMEA Partner Success Manager to shape and operationalise our Global Partner Services programs—building effective partner engagement, enablement, readiness, and collaboration across the region. As part of Customer Value, you’ll support partner services across the customer lifecycle, from pre-sales alignment and delivery readiness through co-delivery and post-live adoption. Working with major systems integrators and consulting firms, you’ll help evolve a value-focused model that starts earlier in the customer journey and extends beyond implementation to improve conversion, accelerate time to value, increase platform usage, and strengthen long-term customer outcomes. You’ll bring a strong operator’s mindset: turning ambiguity into clear, repeatable ways of working across Sales, Alliances, Technical Services, Customer Success, and external partners. You’ll use data to improve program performance and, based in London, spend regular time in the office and face-to-face with partners to build relationships and help them succeed. What you'll do: Own relationships with strategic partners’ practice and delivery leaders, aligning on priorities, readiness, quality expectations, capacity, and growth opportunities. Partner with Sales, Alliances, and Customer Value to match qualified opportunities with the right partner, co-delivery model, and implementation approach based on customer needs, deal context, partner readiness, and expectations. Operationalise partner engagement across the customer lifecycle—from discovery and scoping through readiness planning, delivery transition, and post-live support—clarifying roles and setting engagements up for execution and adoption. Evolve partner programs with Partner Alliances, Enablement, and Customer Value leadership, including co-delivery and subcontracting frameworks, onboarding, certification, methodology alignment, delivery quality, and ongoing enablement. Assess partner capacity, coverage, skills, and readiness against business demand and EMEA growth priorities; coordinate capacity planning across strategic and subcontracting relationships to improve predictability. Build targeted partner enablement plans across product knowledge, implementation, integrations, value selling, customer change management, AI use cases, and emerging AI consumption models; help partners adapt capabilities and commercial/delivery approaches as opportunities evolve. Work with EA and partner teams to understand partner ISV offerings, technology ecosystems, integrations, and customer architecture requirements, and connect differentiated capabilities to customer opportunities.

jobs.description: Mission Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear. In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives. Role Purpose We are looking for a hands-on Medical Recruiter to help us scale our UK clinical teams. This is a delivery-focused role: you will own the full recruitment lifecycle, from intake and sourcing through interviews, offer and close, across a range of clinical and medical roles. Our clinical teams are at the heart of the Neko experience. They deliver the care that helps our members start their preventative health journey, so every hire directly shapes the quality of that care. We are moving quickly, and this hiring is about precision and pace. You will work closely with hiring managers and clinical leaders to hire outstanding professionals who want to work in a tech-enabled, forward-thinking environment. What you'll do in the first 6-12 Months End-to-end recruitment for UK clinical and medical roles (e.g. doctors, advanced nurse practitioners, registered nurses, healthcare assistants, biomedical scientists, echocardiographers, clinical operations), managing a full requisition load against agreed hiring plans. Source proactively across job boards, direct outreach, referrals, professional networks and events, and adjust channels based on response and conversion data. Own the candidate experience from first contact to offer, with clear communication and fast turnaround at every stage. Keep Ashby accurate and current, so pipeline reporting and Workday alignment can be trusted without manual cleanup. Use data to track pipeline performance, identify bottlenecks, and continuously improve hiring outcomes. Minimum Requirements 3 to 5 years of recruitment experience, ideally hiring healthcare professionals in the UK or in other regulated, high-volume environments such as luxury retail, hospitality or similar service-led settings where standards and pace both matter. Proven success hiring talent from top-performing companies, scale-ups, or mission-driven organisations. Strong sourcing capabilities with a creative, research-led approach to finding exceptional talent. Self-sufficient, proactive and comfortable operating in fast-moving, high-context environments. Clear, professional communication with clinicians and internal teams alike. Comfortable using AI tools to speed up sourcing, outreach and admin, and to sharpen your own judgment. Familiarity with UK clinical registration and pre-employment checks (GMC, NMC, HCPC, DBS, right to work) is helpful, but not essential. We’ll teach you the rest. We offer a dynamic work environment with a high degree of autonomy that fosters growth and development. If you are passionate about building a better healthcare system for everyone and you thrive in a fast-paced environment, we would love to hear from you. jobs.title: Senior Product Data Analyst - Consumer Growth
jobs.description: SumUp | Senior Data Analyst - Consumer Growth | London, United Kingdom Competitive salary · Office-first This role does not support Visa sponsorship and candidates must have the right to work in the UK. About the team SumUp is best known for helping small businesses get paid — our Consumer tribe builds the other half of that story. jobs.title: Senior Application Security Engineer
jobs.description: About Nabla Nabla delivers a unified clinical AI platform used by healthcare organizations across specialties and care settings. The platform includes: Ambient AI documentation that captures clinical conversations and generates structured notes. AI-powered dictation and clinical workflow tools embedded directly within EHR systems. Agentic AI capabilities that support multi-step clinical and administrative tasks. Enterprise-grade infrastructure built for secure deployment across health systems. About the Role We are scaling our healthcare AI platform, with more products, integrations and AI agents, and more protected health information (PHI) flowing through them. To keep pace, we're growing our security engineering team and looking for an exceptional Senior Security Engineer . Our cloud infrastructure handles highly sensitive healthcare data, so security is core to everything we do. Our engineers already ask the right questions every day: can we use a one-time token here? How long should it live? How do we scope this OAuth Client? You'll work directly with our Lead Security Engineer to bring real AppSec expertise into the product squads, and to strengthen security well beyond them. This is a hands-on, high-impact role. About half your time goes to AppSec , but it is deliberately a broad security engineering role, not a pure code-review or pentest job. You'll regularly cross into platform and cloud, CI/CD and detection, and you'll own problems from start to finish. Code scanning, SCA and AI-driven code review are already running, but there is no AppSec process to undo. The threat-modeling practice, the security review loop, the triage rhythm and the secure-by-default libraries don't exist yet. You'll build them and run them. If you're pragmatic, love working shoulder to shoulder with developers, and want your work to protect patients' most sensitive data, this role is for you. Responsibilities Partner with the product squads as their go-to security engineer: design reviews, per-feature threat modeling, and fast, opinionated answers on authN/authZ, tokens and session design. Secure our authentication and authorization surfaces (OAuth clients, one-time codes, multi-org tenancy, the Core API user API, embedded/postMessage SDKs) and hunt for BOLA, IDOR and broken access control before attackers do. Run the code-security findings loop: triage and prioritize results from our SAST, SCA, secrets and IaC scanners and AI-driven code review, route them to the right owners with SLAs, and drive the dependency-vulnerability backlog down, fixing issues yourself when that's faster. Secure our AI/LLM features and internal agents, covering prompt injection, tool and permission scoping for autonomous agents, PHI leakage, de-identification assurance and model/API egress. Run the external testing program: scope and run pentests (web, mobile, backoffice), validate fixes, operate our vulnerability disclosure program, and stand up a bug bounty. Build secure-by-default guardrails (secure coding guidelines, hardened libraries and patterns, pre-commit and PR checks) so the secure path is the easy path. Qualifications 5 to 8+ years in security engineering, including at least 2 to 3 years in application or product security, or experience as a software engineer with a strong security focus. Deep understanding of modern web and API security: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, session and token design, multi-tenancy, and the OWASP Top 10 and API Top 10. You can find access-control flaws by reading code. Strong coder, comfortable reading and fixing production code (mostly Kotlin and Python, plus web, mobile and desktop clients) and automating in Python. Experience running threat modeling and security design reviews, and operating SAST, SCA and secrets scanning in CI with a real triage loop, not just a dashboard. Genuine breadth: comfortable moving between an API design review, a supply-chain hardening PR and an incident in the same week, and honest about what you don't know yet

jobs.description: We are growing! We are currently looking to hire a Director, Luxury Market Intelligence & Insights .   About CXG: Founded in 2006, CXG is a global customer experience company uniquely positioned at the intersection of data-driven retail performance, customer experience transformation, and operational execution across 200+ luxury brands worldwide. The mission of our 270 collaborators is to help brands transform customer and employee experiences through tailored insights, strategy, and implementation. We are passionate about delivering impact. Our clients include the world's most admired luxury houses, and our solutions combine research, technology, and human expertise to elevate every customer interaction. We are looking for a thought leadership expert with the editorial vision to spot what matters next, the conviction to shape CXG's point of view, and the writing talent to make it influential across luxury retail, beauty and cosmetics, watches and jewellery, automotive, and hospitality. Context and role Reporting to the Chief of Staff, you will lead CXG's Thought Leadership and Market Intelligence functions. You will define the topics on which CXG should have a distinctive and credible point of view, turn CXG's proprietary data, expertise and market knowledge into original external content, and position the company ahead of emerging developments in customer experience, luxury and its priority verticals. This is a hands-on role: you will research, analyse, write and produce content yourself, while mobilising expertise and data from across the business. You will be accountable for ensuring that every publication presents a recognisable CXG angle rather than simply reporting market developments or repeating established industry views. You will manage one Market Intelligence team member. Thought Leadership Development Define the thought leadership strategy and roadmap, including priority themes, target audiences, formats and a realistic publication calendar. Drive and coordinate content creation across Practices, Solutions and Regions. Work closely with Practices, Regions and Solutions to: Push: scan for trends and hot topics and ensure CXG has a voice and perspective, commenting regularly on these subjects. Pull: identify and collect new ideas and proposed topics from the relevant stakeholders, prioritise and incorporate them into the thought leadership roadmap. Use market intelligence, CXG's proprietary data, internal expertise and client-facing insights to identify emerging topics early, develop a clear CXG point of view and decide where CXG can make a credible contribution to the conversation. Research, interview internal experts, write and edit articles, perspectives and other thought leadership content directly. Challenge generic claims and ensure each piece advances a clear argument and is supported by credible evidence. Ensure that analysis is methodologically sound, appropriately contextualised and presented without compromising client confidentiality. Develop topics that connect expertise across Practices and Regions, while reflecting relevant differences between markets. Thought Leadership Communication Ensure relevant thought leadership pieces (e.g., perspectives, publications) are disseminated on a periodic basis. Work with Marketing on the publication, distribution and promotion of content, while retaining ownership of the editorial strategy, substance, quality and consistency of CXG's point of view. In addition, collaborate with Marketing to maximise impact by communicating through the channels relevant to each market. Track the reach, engagement and qualitative response generated by CXG's thought leadership, as well as relevant business enquiries influenced by published content. Use the findings to refine the roadmap. Shape and host or contribute to CXG's podcast "The Luxury Edit", working with internal experts and guests to develop topics, prepare interviews and turn conversations into useful content

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, ML Platform
jobs.description: The Senior Machine Learning Engineer, ML Platform is responsible for building, running, and evolving the ML monorepo used by the X-ray, CT, and MRI machine learning group at DeepHealth. The monorepo covers the full path from experimentation to product: dataset and sample definitions, training and evaluation code, experiment tracking, model export, and the inference servers that run in production. Everyone on the team contributes to the monorepo; this role is the single point of accountability for it. This hands-on role owns the architecture, tooling, and engineering standards of that codebase for a distributed team of about twenty machine learning engineers and scientists, working with model developers and software engineers to make the team’s work fast, better, and easier to audit. It also leads the team's agentic coding strategy, shaping how AI coding agents are used across the codebase. The role reports to the Leader of the ML for X-ray/CT/MRI group. Essential Duties and Responsibilities   Own the architecture and roadmap of the ML Monorepo: Module boundaries, shared abstractions for datasets and samples, training and evaluation loops, configuration, and experiment tracking. Build and run the engineering tooling around the codebase: Continuous integration, testing, dependency management, containers, artifact and model registries, and GPU job scheduling on cloud (GCP) and HPC infrastructure. Own the path from trained checkpoint to deployable model: Model packaging, inference servers with enforced API contracts, reproducibility, and performance and memory budgets on target hardware. Define and enforce engineering standards (code review, testing, documentation) in a way that accelerates research rather than slowing it down. Ensure traceability of data, code, and model versions across experiments and releases. Investigate and resolve performance, reliability, and usability issues in the stack raised by the team and reduce their recurrence through shared tooling. Drive the team's agentic coding strategy: define how AI coding agents are used in the monorepo, set up the tooling, guardrails, and conventions that make them effective, and help colleagues adopt them. Review code, mentor colleagues on engineering practices, and communicate technical decisions and trade-offs clearly. PLEASE NOTE: This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and requirements of the position described above.  Other functions may be assigned and management retains the right to add or change duties at any time. Minimum Qualifications, Education and Experience  Master's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience (required). 5+ years of software engineering experience, including a significant portion building infrastructure or tooling used by machine learning teams, such as an ML platform or a training framework (required). Strong Python skills and software engineering fundamentals: API design, testing, refactoring, and attention to developer experience (required). Solid PyTorch knowledge and practical experience with model training and profiling (required). Experience running ML workloads on a cloud platform, ideally GCP (Vertex AI, Artifact Registry, IAM, storage), and with containerization (required). Experience taking models to production: model packaging, inference serving, and performance and reliability constraints (required). Ability to work closely with researchers, translate recurring pain points into shared tooling, and push back constructively when needed (required). Ability to work autonomously in a distributed, multi-site team, with clear verbal and written communication in English (required). Medical imaging experience (DICOM, 3D volumes, large images) (preferred). HPC and Slurm experience (preferred). Contributions to open-source ML tooling (preferred). Quality Standards  Communicates, cooperates, and consistently functions professional

jobs.title: Embedded Engineer
jobs.description: Accelerating embodied AGI. The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century. MicroAGI is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data. We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries. Our models learn from data captured in the physical world, by hardware we design and build ourselves. As Embedded Engineer, you will own the firmware that runs on that hardware, from the first register write to the moment data leaves the device, so that what reaches our ML team is clean, synchronized, and trustworthy. What You Will Do Write and own the firmware for our data-capture hardware: sensors, motion-capture rigs, custom IoT setups, and prototype robots. Build real-time data acquisition: drivers, DMA, buffering, and streaming from many sensors at once without dropping a sample. Solve multi-sensor synchronization, calibration, and time-stamping so every data point lines up across devices and modalities. Bring up new boards with our Electrical Engineer and turn fresh hardware into working devices fast. Build the path from device to dataset: communication protocols, on-device logging, and handoff into our data pipeline. Work shoulder to shoulder with ML engineers. Your firmware decides what their training data looks like, and a timing bug can quietly ruin months of data. Make firmware reliable in the field: testing, OTA updates, error handling, and diagnostics that tell us what went wrong. Requirements Up to 5 years writing production firmware for embedded or IoT systems. Strong C/C++, experience with an RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, or similar), and deep familiarity with microcontrollers (STM32, ESP32, NXP, or similar). Hands-on experience with peripheral interfaces and protocols: SPI, I2C, UART, USB, BLE, CAN, or similar. Experience integrating sensors in firmware: IMUs, cameras, depth sensors, force sensors, or similar. A strong understanding of how firmware decisions affect data quality, especially for EMG/EEG sensing: ADC configuration, sample rate, jitter, filtering, and buffering. You know that a great model on a noisy signal still loses to a decent model on a clean one, and you write code accordingly. Comfortable debugging at the hardware boundary with a logic analyzer, oscilloscope, and debugger. Genuinely curious about ML: you read papers, you have trained at least one model end to end, and you understand that dataset quality beats model architecture choice. High agency: you don't wait to be told what to do. You are comfortable in 0-to-1 ambiguity, where the spec is "figure out what the spec should be". Experience with real-time or hard-deadline systems: audio, video sync, or robotic control loops. Experience with embedded Linux, time-sync protocols (PTP or similar), or low-power design. Familiarity with ML training pipelines. Even if you don't run them, you can read a training script. Open-source firmware contributions. jobs.title: Characterization Lead
jobs.description: At Kandou , we are redeﬁning the economics of AI infrastructure. Our mission is to democratise AI by signiﬁcantly reducing the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) of hardware systems — a critical barrier to scalable adoption. Our proprietary MIMO-over-copper technology powers a high-performance, chiplet-based AI memory fabric that is both scalable and energy-efficient . Unlike traditional interconnects, our solution reduces power consumption signiﬁcantly while preserving high bandwidth and ultra-low latency — unlocking unprecedented efficiency for AI training and inference at scale. As Characterization Lead, you will own performance characterization of Zinal retimer silicon and the Randa Active Electrical Cable (AEC) channel. This is a Principal / Senior Staff individual contributor role with hands-on technical leadership. Your measurements will establish datasheet limits, channel classes and guard-bands for validation, manufacturing and customer specifications. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. The Analytics Engineers who serve these teams own the data modelling layer that all of it runs on: dbt models, metric definitions, and semantic layer contributions that analysts, product teams, and AI tools depend on to get consistent, trustworthy answers. You'll be embedded in the Product Intelligence team, building the tracking, experimentation, and data modelling foundations that make product data trustworthy and self-serve. You'll join a close-knit team actively migrating our analytics stack onto a new Analytics Warehouse and Omni, moving off legacy tools like Looker and Hippocampus. Define and document metrics in our semantic layer, ensuring a single authoritative definition so downstream BI tools and AI applications yield consistent answers. Apply AI-augmented data modelling practices as a standard part of how you write, review, and migrate code. Partner with Product Managers and Analysts to turn one-off questions into durable, reusable data models. Maintain data quality in your domain through dbt tests, freshness SLAs, and proactive monitoring. What you bring Solid SQL and dbt experience, with a clear comfort owning models end to end. jobs.title: Marketing Analyst, Attribution - ShareGate
jobs.description: Company Description Workleap is a Montreal-based tech company, founded in 2006. We're builders at heart, we make simple products that actually matter to the people who use them. We have two product lines: Workleap Agent , our newest solution built to make every manager more effective, and ShareGate , the world's leading solution for Microsoft 365 migration and governance. More than 15,000 companies worldwide trust us to do exactly that. We're intentional about who joins us. If you're the kind of person who gets excited by a hard problem and wants to help shape what comes next, there's a place for you here. Your role ShareGate is a close to $100M ARR business that grows through two very different engines: inbound and channel. We've just finished our CRM migration and locked down our revenue architecture, which means for the first time the data is clean enough to answer the question we've never been able to answer properly — what marketing actually drives revenue, and where the next dollar should go. This role exists to own that answer. You'll be the analytical counterpart to our marketing ops lead, working side by side with ShareGate's Director of Marketing to turn campaign and attribution data into decisions the marketing team and the exec team can act on. Your impact: Own ShareGate's marketing attribution architecture across HubSpot and HockeyStack, and translate funnel data into exec-ready narratives, so attribution questions get one clear answer; Drive marketing performance by diagnosing what's working and what isn't across inbound and channel, so budget shifts to the highest-return programs every quarter instead of every fiscal year; Build the reporting and diagnostic layer for ShareGate marketing — campaign performance, funnel conversion, source quality — so the team plans against measured conversion rates, not assumptions; Integrate AI into the analysis workflow — we run on Claude — to compress the time from question to answer from days to hours, and to make deep-dive analysis a weekly habit rather than a quarterly project. Your team The next 6 to 12 months are a build. This role has never existed at Workleap, and you're inheriting a business that just finished cleaning its foundations: the CRM migration is done, the revenue architecture is set, and attribution visibility is still scattered across two systems. Your first mandate is to make that architecture coherent and legible — then use it to tell ShareGate's marketing team where to invest and where to pull back. RevOps at Workleap is split into two halves. One is Systems & Operations, which owns automation, CRM architecture and AI GTM tooling. The other — yours — is a group of GTM business partners embedded with the business units they serve, accountable for their stakeholder's performance: forecasting, funnel conversion, quota attainment, velocity. You'll report to the Director of RevOps and pair tightly with our Marketing Ops Manager, who owns the systems and campaign execution, while you own the data and its interpretation. What you'll bring 3+ years in marketing operations or marketing analytics at a B2B SaaS, software or fintech company; Deep hands-on HubSpot expertise — non-negotiable. You've built, broken and rebuilt campaign, lifecycle and reporting logic inside it; A real command of attribution models — first touch, last touch, multi-touch — and the judgment to know which one answers which question; Fluency with the mechanics underneath: UTM governance, lead routing and round robins, lifecycle stages, source and channel taxonomy; An analyst's instinct: you chase the "why" behind a number before anyone asks you to; The ability to take a messy dataset and turn it into a two-slide answer a CRO can act on; Deliberate daily use of AI to accelerate your own analysis — not just to draft copy; Bonus: experience with HockeyStack or a comparable attribution platform. Most of this sounds like you? Apply. What the job comes with Base salary: $100k to $130k / OTE: $11

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations. jobs.title: Head of Data Science
jobs.description: What do we do? Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better. We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally. The role: We are looking for a Head of Data Science to build Paddle's data science capability from the ground up. Our Merchant of Record model gives us a data position no PSP or billing provider has: subscription and pricing context alongside granular payment-outcome data, across thousands of software businesses. This role exists to turn that into economic value by putting machine learning and agentic systems into production. The mandate is deliberately narrow and deliberately ambitious: data science at Paddle owns automated decisioning inside the product — traditional machine learning and agentic systems alike — not decision-support analytics. We have a long list of candidate opportunities than we can fund, spanning payment performance and revenue recovery, sales and marketing operations, growth and monetisation intelligence, and risk, trust and compliance. We have a working hypothesis about which of these pays back first, and we'll share it — but part of the job in your first quarter is to pressure-test it, size the alternatives yourself, and tell us where to start. This is a founding role, and for the first few quarters it is a building role more than a managing one. You'll be the only person in the function: doing the analysis, engineering the features, training and evaluating the models or agents, taking the first system live with our engineering teams — and then operating it, answerable for its uptime, its drift and its numbers. Once the first use cases are proving out, you'll hire and lead a hub-and-spoke team of data scientists and machine learning engineers embedded across our highest-value business areas. You'll report into the VP of Data and work in close partnership with Product, Payments, Engineering, Risk and Finance. What you'll do: Prioritise which opportunities have the biggest impact.. Build a value-based use-case backlog across payment performance and revenue recovery, sales and marketing operations, growth and monetisation intelligence, and risk, trust and compliance; size the leading candidates properly; and make the call on sequencing with the relevant Product, Risk, RevOps and Finance stakeholders. This gets refreshed quarterly. Personally deliver the first system end to end: the analysis and back-test, the features, the model, policy or agent, the deployment, and the shadow and A/B tests that prove it works. Not a spec handed to someone else to build. Operate what you deploy. Own monitoring, retraining, drift response, incident handling and rollback for live decisioning, alongside the engineering teams whose services call it — and set the expectation that the function runs its systems rather than shipping them. Work across both traditional ML and agentic systems, and be honest about which a problem actually needs: a propensity or uplift model, a policy of rules, or an agent with tools, evals against golden answer sets and trace-level observability. Several of our strongest candidate use cases point each way. Build and lead the team — hire senior data scientists embedded in value areas and machine learning engineers in the hub, and set the professional standards, shared methods and reusable components the function runs on. Establish the production stack alongside Data Platform and Engineering: reproducible training data, code and artefacts; a model registry; inference services with real latency, availability and rollback requirements; historically accurate features where decisions

jobs.title: Senior Applied Data Scientist, Fleet Intelligence
jobs.description: A little about us… Fleetio is a modern software platform that helps thousands of organizations worldwide manage their fleet operations. Transportation technology is a hot market, and we’re leading the charge with raving fans and new customers signing up every day. We raised $450M in our Series D funding round in March of 2025 and are on an exciting trajectory as a company. Fleetio is also a proud founding member of the Rails Foundation ! More about our team and company: Fleetio overview video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YoXyXTFWbkg Our careers page: https://www.fleetio.com/careers Fleetio is looking for a product-minded Senior Applied Data Scientist to join our Fleet Intelligence team. You will help turn years of fleet maintenance and operational data into trusted, actionable intelligence that helps customers anticipate what is ahead and make better decisions about usage, cost, availability, maintenance risk, and asset lifecycle. This is an applied role at the intersection of data science, machine learning, analytics engineering, and product development. You will work closely with Product Managers, Designers, Software Engineers, and Data partners to identify valuable prediction problems, develop practical models, and bring them into customer-facing workflows. Your goal is to deliver intelligence that changes a decision, arrives early enough to act on, and communicates uncertainty honestly. Your initial mandate will be grounded in confirmed Fleet Intelligence work: utilization and tire intelligence, ROI measurement, existing predictive models, and the analytics foundations needed to support customer-facing intelligence. You will assess current model quality, establish credible baselines, and help the team ship useful capabilities while strengthening its data-science practices. Over time, you will help evaluate and shape opportunities for Predictive Fleet Intelligence, including projection, anticipation, and risk inference. You will help determine which opportunities are technically credible, valuable to customers, and ready to become durable product investments. More About Our Team and Company Watch our culture videos: https://fleet.io/culture Engineering culture, interview process, and videos: https://www.fleetio.com/careers/engineering Fleetio overview video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IlvIbwZT3oU More about the Fleetio platform: https://www.fleetio.com/features API docs: https://developer.fleetio.com This is a remote opportunity and is open to candidates in the United States, Canada, or Mexico. Who You Are You are an applied data scientist who enjoys working on ambiguous, high-value product problems. You can translate a customer or business decision into a measurable modeling problem, establish a credible baseline, and iteratively improve it. You know when straightforward statistics or deterministic projection is the right answer and when a machine learning approach is warranted. You care deeply about correctness, explainability, and trust. You are comfortable communicating confidence intervals, limitations, and data gaps to technical and non-technical partners. You collaborate well with software and data engineers, but you can independently explore data, build production-quality models, define evaluation methods, and guide how model outputs should appear in a product experience. You are pragmatic, product-minded, and outcome-oriented. You would rather ship a useful, well-calibrated forecast than an impressive model that does not change a customer decision. Your Impact Help deliver near-term Fleet Intelligence initiatives, including tire intelligence, utilization intelligence, ROI measurement, existing predictive models, and the analytical foundations that support customer-facing intelligence. Evaluate and develop credible projections or predictive models for fleet usage, maintenance cost, availability, condition and failure risk, and asset lifecycle decisions as product direction and evidence mature. jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist, Audio
jobs.description: Company Overview Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram. Company Operating Rhythm At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance. Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do. Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5. Deepgram is looking for a Data Scientist to sit at the intersection between research and data: people who think deeply about what conversational data is actually composed of, what makes data valuable, and how to best leverage that. Conversational audio presents incredibly rich scientific, engineering, and infrastructure challenges that are orders of magnitude harder than working with text. Speech carries speakers, accents, dialects, emotion, overlapping talk, code-switching, domain vocabulary, and acoustic conditions that range from a quiet studio to a drive-through — all with rich context that moves the conversation. In this role you'll collaborate closely with our research, engineering, and data teams to answer those questions rigorously and at scale. You'll care deeply about what makes conversational data difficult, you'll characterize it, and you'll shape the strategies that turn it into model gains. This role rewards conviction, creativity in approach, and a real appetite for overturning your own assumptions when the data says otherwise. This is a hands-on, high-leverage role with unusual latitude to define an area from first principles. It reports to the VP of Data Operations. We're looking for people who: See "we've always done it this way" as a starting position to argue with, not a constraint to work around Can find the one experiment that settles a question in days rather than months Are creative about where signal hides — in metadata, in model confidence, in the failures Have the vision to take a scrappy proof-of-concept and scale it 100x Are obsessed with using AI to automate and amplify their own impact What You'll Own Understand and characterize our data. Build the analysis that tells us what we actually have — languages, conditions, domains, speakers, quality — and what's underrepresented. Design and build active-learning loops. Decide what's worth working on next based on where it will move performance, and make that decision systematic rather than intuitive. Think deeply about how to best leverage humans in the loop. jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description: RevenueCat gives app businesses the infrastructure and tools to build, run, and improve their monetization. Since graduating from YC's S18 batch, we've grown into the default monetization platform for mobile. We're in 50%+ of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $16B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo developer to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue. We're a remote-first team of 150+ people across 25+ countries, guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance. This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading. The role We're hiring a Data Analyst to work as close as possible to the teams that run RevenueCat's business, including Marketing, Sales, Finance, People, Ops, Product, etc. The most valuable thing on our Analytics team today isn't SQL, it's domain knowledge. Knowing what a trial start actually counts, why tracked revenue and realized revenue are different, how store refunds land in our data, and which model answers a question correctly the first time. That knowledge is what turns a half-formed Slack question into a number someone can act on within the hour. So you'll spend most of your time with business teams: understanding what they're trying to decide, turning vague questions into analysis, and shipping the datasets and dashboards they rely on. You'll build that domain knowledge fast, working day to day with the person who currently owns Analytics here. He'll be your closest partner and the person who helps you grow into the domain. The second thing that makes this role exciting is how we expect you to work. We're building the infrastructure that lets AI agents access our data safely, and agentic tooling that answers questions grounded in our semantic layer rather than guessing. You'll be one of its heaviest users and one of the people who makes it trustworthy: curating the semantic context, catching the answers that look right and aren't, and pushing definitions back into dbt and LookML where they belong. We're not hiring someone to do the same volume of work faster, we're hiring someone who supports multiple teams well using this collection of new tools as a force multiplier. What you will do Partner regularly with Marketing, Sales, Finance and Product teams. Learn their goals, their metrics, and the decisions they're actually stuck on. Own analysis end to end: clarify the real question, build or pick the right dataset, deliver the answer, and make sure a decision follows. Go deep on our subscription domain, then write it down. Metric definitions, caveats, always-filters, known gotchas. Domain knowledge that only lives in your head doesn't scale, and scaling it is the point of this role. Build analytics assets people trust without asking you first: models in dbt, explores in LookML, dashboards that hold up. Use our agent tooling as a force multiplier and contribute back to it. Feed it semantic context, flag wrong answers, harden the definitions it depends on. Contribute to the data platform where it unblocks you. Small model and pipeline improvements, debugging discrepancies, helping out when something breaks. Translate in both directions: business context into robust analysis, data reality into language a non-technical stakeholder can act on. About you 3+ years in an analytics role (Data Analyst, BI Analyst, Business Analyst, Analytics Engineer or similar), including real experience as the direct analytics partner to a business team such as Marketing, Sales or Finance. Curiosity is the thing we're actually screening for: You're uncomfortable when you don't understand why a number is what

jobs.title: Research Scientist - Personalization
jobs.description: The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify ’s most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.Spotify’s Personalization organization builds the technology that helps millions of listeners discover what they love. Within this space, our research team focuses on advancing the state of the art in machine learning and AI to shape the future of personalization. We explore new approaches, challenge existing assumptions, and contribute to the broader research community while influencing long-term product direction. What You'll Do Conduct original research in machine learning and AI, with a focus on large-scale foundation models, generative AI, and post-training methods, including reinforcement learning. Develop novel methodologies, models, and evaluation frameworks to advance personalization systems. Design and execute rigorous experiments to explore new ideas and validate research hypotheses. Contribute to the scientific community through publications, talks, and conference participation. Collaborate with cross-functional partners to translate research insights into long-term product opportunities. Help define and evolve a forward-looking research agenda aligned with Spotify’s personalization strategy. Mentor others and contribute to a strong, curious, and collaborative research culture. Who You Are You have a Master’s or PhD in machine learning, AI, or a related field, or equivalent research experience. You have demonstrated expertise in machine learning and artificial intelligence through peer-reviewed publications at conferences such as NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, KDD, or RecSys. You have deep knowledge of machine learning, with hands-on experience in areas such as post-training and reinforcement learning for large models, reward design, large-scale distributed training, or evaluation of model behavior. You are experienced in designing experiments and working with real-world datasets to validate research ideas. You care about advancing understanding of user behavior and improving experiences across music and talk content. You bring curiosity, creativity, and a thoughtful approach to solving complex, open-ended problems. You value collaboration and actively seek diverse perspectives in your work. Where You'll Be This role is based in London. We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home. Compensation Additional Information Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens. At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

jobs.title: Senior Decision Scientist
jobs.description: At Instructure , we believe in the power of people to grow and succeed throughout their lives. Our goal is to amplify that power by creating intuitive products that simplify learning and personal development, facilitate meaningful relationships, and inspire people to go further in their education and careers. We do this by giving smart, creative, passionate people opportunities to create awesome. And that's where you come in: As a Senior Decision Scientist, you will drive meaningful business outcomes by leading complex analytical initiatives and serving as a trusted partner to senior stakeholders. What you will do: Drive business impact through data-driven insights. Identify and pursue high-value opportunities to improve product adoption, customer engagement, and revenue growth using advanced analytical and statistical methods. Lead experimentation and causal analysis. Design and execute rigorous A/B tests and causal inference studies to evaluate the impact of new product features, pricing strategies, and go-to-market initiatives. Champion experimental rigor across teams. Influence product and business strategy. Partner with product managers, engineers, marketing leaders, and senior stakeholders to translate complex business questions into structured analytical frameworks and deliver strategic recommendations. Deliver end-to-end analytical solutions. Own the full lifecycle of analytical initiatives — from identifying opportunities and building models to deploying solutions and measuring impact. Default to AI-first thinking. Design analysis approaches, recommend solutions, and elevate standards and throughput across the team by leveraging AI tooling and modern analytical techniques. Contribute to decision science best practices. Help define standards for experimentation, modeling, and insight delivery that raise the bar for analytical quality across the organization.
