jobs.title: Lead BI Developer
jobs.description: WHO ARE WE? Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz , All About Cookies , and OnlyInYourState . We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies. Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment. We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries. WHY JOIN US? You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato . BASE SALARY: $120,000 to $150,000 per year, paid semi-monthly MUST HAVE: Expert SQL & Comfortable with Unstructured Complex Data : Extracts accurate insights from raw, unstructured data without relying on clean models Reporting Ownership & Data Literacy : Builds, standardizes, drives adoption, and leaves teams more data-literate Performance Marketing Optimization : Connects data directly to levers that move the business, i.e. campaign performance, conversion rates, or revenue per session Advanced LookML Development (or equivalent in Power BI / Tableau) : Architects complex models with full understanding of downstream impacts Curiosity & Business Depth : Asks questions first; driven to grow business knowledge to become a trusted analytical partner, not just a builder EXPERIENCE: Minimum 7 years in business intelligence or analytics with direct exposure to performance or affiliate marketing. The strongest candidates have owned reporting end-to-end, from pipeline to dashboard, worked with messy, complex, third-party data, and partnered closely with business teams to uncover meaningful trends, conduct retrospective analyses, and connect data work to decisions that actually moved the business. YOUR ROLE Launch Potato is looking for a Lead BI Developer to own the reporting infrastructure that powers decision-making across our Credit Cards, Make Money/Manage Money, Banking, and Marketplace verticals with a clear growth path into becoming a proactive analytical partner who helps the team see around corners. You'll be embedded with the business from day one, partnering closely with our Yield, Paid Media, and Account Management teams to uncover meaningful trends, conduct retrospective analyses across experiments, creatives, offers, seasonality, and CAC performance, and challenge the team with insights they aren't currently seeing. This is NOT a role for someone who wants to build dashboards and hand them off, it's for someone who cares deeply about whether the work they build gets used, understood, and acted on. Outcomes (Performance Expectations) 30 Days in: Actively engaged with stakeholders to audit what reporting the team is consuming and why, i.e. identifying discrepancies, redundancies, and inconsistencies across existing dashboards and beginning to develop a roadmap to standardize reporting across your verticals. 60 Days in: Bridging business context and data understanding by being able to articulate how assigned verticals make money and what the key performance levers are. Actively improving dashboard standardization while executing on ad hoc requests with accuracy and business context. 90 Days in: Dashboard standardization is in execution and a clear roadmap exists for how trusted data sources will be developed to improve the efficiency of data consumption. LookML structure is understood well enough to begin making changes with full awareness of downstream impacts. Working relationships with Yield, Paid Media, and Account Management are established. 6 Months in: Trust is built with the business

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games. Discord seeks a seasoned Data Engineer, focusing on our advertising product data. In this role, you will drive technical vision and strategy for ads data engineering in support of our ML initiatives while building and maintaining sophisticated data pipelines, datasets, and analytical tools. If leading technical innovation, architecting scalable solutions, and empowering teams through data excites you, we encourage you to make a move! Drive alignment across Data Science, ML Engineering, Ads Product, and GTM teams through clear narratives that connect data infrastructure decisions to business outcomes and revenue impact. Mentor engineers through technical challenges, code and design reviews, and ownership of complex projects - contributing to the culture and engineering standards of the Data Engineering team team. Deep expertise in digital advertising data engineering - specifically in ads delivery, conversion measurement, attribution pipelines, or ML feature data infrastructure. Experience with Conversion Data and APIs, MMP integrations, or identity graph infrastructure is strongly valued. Demonstrated experience building data models in a greenfield or 0-to-1 environment where requirements change frequently, documentation is sparse, and architectural decisions are made with incomplete information. jobs.description: Thumbtack helps millions of people confidently care for their homes. Thumbtack is the one app you need to take care of and improve your home — from personalized guidance to AI tools and a best-in-class hiring experience. Every day in every county of the U.S., people turn to Thumbtack to complete urgent repairs, seasonal maintenance and bigger improvements. We help homeowners know which projects to do, when to do them and who to hire from our growing community of 300,000 local service businesses. If making an impact inspires you, join us. Imagine what we’ll build together. About the Applied Science Team We’re looking for applied scientists with deep expertise in machine learning, optimization, building data products, and/or statistical models. As part of a small product team you will have full ownership over your domain, so you should be a person who dreams big, then executes well. At Thumbtack, the Applied Science team is responsible for a wide variety of problems spanning AI, machine learning, statistics, and computer science: Improve customer and service provider matching. Matching and optimization algorithms are fundamental to Thumbtack’s product: we now service millions of matches per week. Identifying better matches between customers and service providers has an incredible impact on the experience of customers and professionals transacting on our platform. Model complex relationships in the presence of many confounding factors. Predictive modeling problems are everywhere across our product. Our team works to scope, design and implement machine learning models to support Thumbtack’s product and marketing. Characterize marketplace dynamics. Thumbtack’s marketplaces consist of thousands of active markets across our service categories and U.S. cities. Via exploratory data analysis and experimental design, our team works to understand trends and behaviors within these markets. Build AI features. Use state-of-the-art approaches such as large language models (LLMs), reinforcement learning and agentic workflows to enhance customer / pro experience, increase acquisition and marketplace efficiency, and to automate and enhance internal processes. Build a healthy marketplace. We evolve and manage the monetization mechanics of our marketplace, including defining the parameters that affect the prices we charge. The challenge Thumbtack constantly works to balance supply and demand across thousands of local markets and hundreds of service categories. The Pro Growth pod is responsible for the science behind acquiring and activating the right pros, at the right time, in the right markets, to keep the marketplace healthy and growing. As an Applied Scientist on Pro Growth, you’ll build models and experiments that shape who joins Thumbtack, how they get activated, how we forecast supply needs by market and trade, and how we accelerate time-to-value for new pros. We leverage machine learning, causal inference, and optimization to strategically grow and shape our pro supply base. Our work directly contributes to meeting demand projections, unlocking strategic partnerships, and ultimately enhancing customer experience and platform growth by ensuring a robust and high-quality supply of pros. You’ll work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineers, product managers, and other applied scientists on a portfolio that ranges from incrementality and market forecasting to LLM-powered onboarding agents. You’ll own end-to-end: from problem framing, through experiment design, through deploying models to production, through measuring business impact. We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes. Organizations rely on ExtraHop to provide visibility into the cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and network performance issues that evade their existing security and IT tools. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running. Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. jobs.description: About the Role Elite Editing is seeking experienced freelance journalists and content professionals to support our growing customer reference and case study programs. We call this our Storyteller role, and we are specifically looking for experienced professionals based in EMEA and APAC time zones . Our Storytellers own the storytelling process from interview through finished draft. They lead kickoff calls with our clients and their internal stakeholders, interview their customers and subject matter experts (SMEs), identify the strongest narrative angles within the information they gather, and then write compelling case studies and customer reference stories that adhere to client-specific standards and style guides. This is more than simply working through a list of prepared questions—or turning a transcript into copy. We need skilled storytellers who listen closely, recognize when an answer deserves further exploration, ask intelligent follow-up questions, identify the details that make a story worth telling, and then shape that material into polished, engaging content. Our ideal freelancer has a journalism or professional interviewing background paired with extensive professional writing experience and strong editorial judgment . You should be comfortable speaking with senior business leaders, technical SMEs, and other professionals; able to quickly understand unfamiliar or complex subject matter; and skilled at transforming what you learn into a clear and compelling narrative. Conduct virtual interviews with our clients' customers and SMEs, often involving senior-level or highly technical professionals. Review project background materials and prepare for interviews in advance. Use provided interview guides as a starting point while adapting questions to the conversation. Ask thoughtful, unscripted follow-up questions that uncover meaningful details, examples, outcomes, challenges, and quotable insights. Identify and develop the strongest story angles from interviews, background materials, and client input. Write polished B2B case studies and customer reference stories based on the information you gather, following client-specific briefs, templates, standards, and style guides. Synthesize complex or technical information into accurate, accessible, and engaging narratives for the intended audience. Maintain a professional, confident, and personable presence while representing Elite and our clients on calls. Follow client-specific processes, confidentiality requirements, and project instructions. Job Requirements Successful candidates must: Have substantial professional writing experience , with a portfolio demonstrating the ability to develop clear, engaging, publication-ready content. We are not a factory. We are not a revolving door. We are a close-knit, values-driven team that operates with intention — every client gets one point of contact, consistent communication, and work they can count on every single month. And solve problems. Rapid, responsive, and reliable communication. Repeatable processes are the only option. If you read those and felt something — keep reading. If you read those and they felt like just words, this is not the right fit, and that is okay. This Is Who We Are NOT Looking For We are a small team doing meaningful work. There is no room for the following: People who cut corners and hope no one notices People who go quiet when things get hard People who need to be micromanaged to deliver People who treat accuracy as optional People who are not genuinely curious about the work they do People who are not committed to the client behind the numbers If any of that describes you, we genuinely wish you well — just not here. The Role The person best suited for this job is organized, detail-oriented, and personable. If you like to put your headphones on and dive into the numbers, you'll love this job. Our team gets to complete something from start to finish every day — there's real joy in putting your head down and checking tasks off one by one. But this role takes more than the obvious skills. jobs.title: Voice AI Engineer
jobs.description: Intro For this position we are only looking for candidates located in Greece, Germany or Austria . Nairon GmbH is a Swiss startup building AI voice agents that answer and make phone calls for businesses. Our platform runs real-time conversations over the phone and on the web, connected to our customers' telephony and business tools. We value clear communication, thoughtful engineering, and a collaborative approach to problem-solving. Join us as we continue to develop tools that make a difference. Tasks As a Voice AI Engineer at Nairon GmbH, you will make our agents sound fast, natural and reliable in live calls. Your responsibilities will include: Improving turn-taking: when the agent speaks, waits, yields or gets interrupted, including voice activity and end-of-turn detection. Cutting end-to-end latency across speech recognition, language models and speech synthesis, and making provider failover seamless. Optimising how we use LLMs in conversation: prompting, tool calls, streaming and speculative or parallel requests. Serving our own speech models (STT and TTS) on GPUs, measuring throughput and time to first audio. Fine-tuning speech and language models for our customers' languages and voices. Building evaluation: test calls, benchmarks and quality metrics that tell us when a change really helps. Requirements Experience: A senior or strong mid-level engineer with production experience in real-time audio, conversational AI or ML model serving. Technical Skills: Required: Strong Python , including asyncio and streaming pipelines. Hands-on work with speech (STT, TTS, VAD) and LLM APIs in latency-sensitive systems. Model serving on GPUs, for example with vLLM or similar, and the basics of batching and memory limits. Nice to have: LiveKit Agents , pipecat or WebRTC. Fine-tuning (LoRA or full) of speech or language models. Audio signal processing such as echo cancellation or noise suppression. German, or experience with German-language speech data. Communication: English proficiency is essential , both written and spoken, as it is the working language for all positions. Soft Skills: You measure before and after, and trust numbers over impressions. Ownership of a problem from the first bad call to the fix in production. Benefits Flexible Work Setup: Work fully remotely or from a co-working space — whichever suits you best. Equipment Provided: Company laptop and phone provided for all employees. Collaborative Environment: Join a small, agile team where your contributions have a direct impact. Growth Opportunities: Work across the whole voice stack, from model serving to the conversation the caller hears. Closing If you want to make AI conversations feel human on a real phone line, we'd love to hear from you. Originally posted on Himalayas

Our mission is to enable the responsible advancement of artificial intelligence by providing the data, evaluation frameworks, and human expertise required to build AI systems that can be trusted at scale. At Davies North America , we’re at the forefront of innovation and excellence, blending cutting-edge technology with top-tier professional services. As a vital part of the global Davies Group, we help businesses navigate risk, optimize operations, and spearhead transformation in the insurance and regulated sectors. What's in StoreThe Workers’ Compensation Claims Supervisor is responsible for overseeing a team of workers’ compensation claims professionals handling medical-only, lost time, and complex workers’ compensation claims. This role ensures claims are managed effectively, in compliance with regulatory requirements, company guidelines, and client expectations. You will provide leadership, coaching, and technical expertise to claims staff while supporting timely claim resolution, cost management, and successful return-to-work outcomes for injured workers. ** Must have an active FL 5-20 or 6-20 license ** Key Responsibilities Team Leadership & Development Supervise and mentor workers’ compensation claims adjusters handling medical-only, lost time, and complex claims. Provide coaching, performance feedback, and technical guidance to claims staff. Support recruitment, onboarding, and professional development initiatives for claims team members. Monitor workload distribution to ensure efficient claims handling and service delivery. Claims Oversight Review complex or high-exposure workers’ compensation claims and provide guidance on claim strategy. Ensure proper claim investigation, documentation, and reserve management. Monitor claim handling practices to ensure compliance with workers’ compensation regulations and company standards. Approve claim settlements within assigned authority limits. Medical & Return-to-Work Coordination Partner with Nurse Case Managers and medical providers to support effective treatment and recovery outcomes. Ensure appropriate return-to-work strategies are implemented when applicable. Monitor medical management strategies to support efficient claim resolution. Client & Operational Performance Serve as a point of contact for clients regarding claim performance and program updates. Monitor operational metrics including claim duration, reserve accuracy, and claim outcomes. Support leadership with reporting and operational insights related to workers’ compensation claims performance. Skills, knowledge & expertise 5+ years of workers’ compensation claims handling experience. Must have a FL 5-20 or 6-20 license Prior supervisory or leadership experience preferred. Strong knowledge of workers’ compensation laws, regulations, and claim handling practices. Excellent leadership, analytical, and communication skills. Oversees day-to-day claims operations for an assigned team. Provides direct leadership to claims adjusters. Monitors team productivity, service delivery standards, and file quality. Conducts file reviews and supports quality initiatives. Assists with staffing coverage, scheduling, and workload balancing. Supports performance feedback and coaching initiatives. Equal Employment Opportunity & Legal Notices Benefits At Davies North America , we are dedicated to supporting the well‑being and future of our qualifying employees. Our comprehensive benefits package includes: Medical, dental, and vision plans to support your health and that of your family A 401(k) plan with employer matching Time‑off policies, including Discretionary Time Off (DTO) for exempt employees and Paid Time Off (PTO) for non‑exempt employees Paid holidays Life insurance and short‑term and long‑term disability coverage Benefit offerings, eligibility, and required employer contributions may vary based on role, classification, and applicable federal, state, and local laws, including those tied to an employee’s primary work location. Where required by law, the Company provides paid sick leave, paid family and parental

jobs.title: Director, Sourcing & Procurement
jobs.description: About Summit: Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit’s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence. Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including: Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI. HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC. HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC. Colorectal Cancer (CRC) HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy. Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has additional offices in California, New Jersey, the UK, and Ireland. Overview of RoleThe Director, Sourcing & Procurement – R&D Clinical Operations and Supplies will serve as business partner supporting sourcing strategy, contracting, and governance activities across Summit’s Clinical Operations organization and global clinical trial portfolio. This individual will report to the Head of Procurement. The role is responsible for supporting the selection, contracting, and oversight of key clinical service providers, including CROs, central laboratories, imaging vendors, eCOA and other eClinical technology providers, patient recruitment and retention suppliers, investigator payment providers, specialty service vendors, and clinical trial supply partners. The position may also support clinical supply and logistics-related procurement activities, helping ensure the timely and cost-effective delivery of materials and services required to execute global clinical studies. The breadth of this role provides significant exposure across the end-to-end clinical development lifecycle and the opportunity to influence sourcing strategy, supplier performance, and operational execution across the clinical portfolio. Working closely with Clinical Operations, R&D, Clinical Supply Chain, Finance, Legal, and other cross-functional stakeholders, this individual will help drive vendor strategy, optimize study-related spending, improve sourcing and contracting processes, mitigate supplier risks, and establish effective governance models with critical suppliers. As Summit continues to grow and expand its clinical development portfolio, this role will have opportunities to support additional R&D and Commercial procurement categories and contribute to broader procurement transformation, process improvement, and vendor management initiatives across the organization. Role And Responsibilities Serve as a lead/procurement business partner to Clinical Operations, providing strategic sourcing and commercial guidance throughout study planning, startup, execution, and closeout. This promotes health equity and builds needed trust in healthcare systems. To accomplish this our teams harness the power of data and AI-technology to unlock groundbreaking medical insights and convert those insights into action that result in optimal patient outcomes and accelerates an equitable and inclusive drug development lifecycle. Visit h1.co to learn more about us. The Finance team's expertise ensures that H1’s financial operations run smoothly and accurately, powering the company’s ability to grow and scale responsibly. jobs.title: 2D Artist - FTC 6 Months
jobs.description: Who are we? StoryToys, an independent subsidiary of Team17 Group plc, is a premier, award-winning developer and publisher of interactive educational apps designed to help children learn, play, and grow. We collaborate with the world’s most recognizable entertainment giants—including The LEGO Group, The Walt Disney Company, Marvel Entertainment, Mattel, and BBC Studios—to bring beloved characters like Bluey, Peppa Pig, and Barbie into engaging digital worlds. Our global success spans all major distribution networks, amassing over 300 million app downloads and reaching millions of active families worldwide in up to 28 different languages. While headquartered in Dublin, Ireland, our internal team of over 130 professionals operates alongside a vast, highly agile global network of creators. About the role We are seeking a talented mid-level 2D Artist with a specialism in UI to join our mobile games development team. You will create engaging, intuitive and visually appealing interfaces for our preschool audience, alongside supporting the wider 2D art needs of our products. Working closely with Design, Engineering, Production and the wider Art Department, you will translate agreed user flows and creative direction into polished UI artwork and production-ready assets. The successful candidate will combine strong 2D art fundamentals with an understanding of how young children interact with games, delivering clear, playful interfaces that reflect our licensed brands and perform well on mobile devices. Requirements Key Responsibilities UI Art Production: Create high-quality screens, buttons, icons, menus, overlays and other interface assets, maintaining clear visual hierarchy and consistency across each product. Child-Friendly Interfaces: Use shape, colour, scale and visual feedback to make interactions understandable for young children, including those who cannot yet read. Work with Design to refine clarity and usability. Brand and Creative Consistency: Translate creative direction and licensed brand guidelines into UI and 2D artwork, responding constructively to internal reviews and partner feedback. UI Systems and Asset Libraries: Build and maintain reusable UI components, style guides and organised asset libraries to support consistent, efficient production. Unity Implementation and Handover: Prepare and export assets with appropriate dimensions, slicing, transparency and naming. Collaborate with Engineering on layout, scaling and implementation, and review the results in Unity and on devices. Wider 2D Art Support: Contribute supporting illustrations, backgrounds, props and other 2D content as required, with UI remaining the primary specialism. Iteration and Quality: Refine artwork through feedback and playtesting. Work with QA and Engineering to resolve visual issues, including screen sizes, aspect ratios and localisation requirements. Agile Delivery: Participate in task estimation, sprint planning and reviews. Communicate progress, dependencies and risks early, and maintain organised source files and production-ready deliverables. Required Skills Professional experience as a 2D or UI Artist in games or interactive media, with the ability to deliver work independently within an agreed brief and seek feedback at appropriate stages. A portfolio demonstrating polished UI artwork, strong visual hierarchy and clear, consistent interface design, alongside sound 2D art fundamentals. Strong understanding of composition, colour, shape language and typography, with the ability to work across different visual styles. Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator, or equivalent 2D art tools, and familiarity with Figma or a comparable interface design tool. Understanding of UI asset preparation for Unity, including sprites, slicing, scalable layouts and efficient texture use. Ability to review artwork in engine and collaborate on implementation. Understanding of mobile interface constraints, including touch targets, device formats, readability

A representative task may require analyzing an airfoil, preparing a computational domain and mesh, defining appropriate boundary conditions, running a CFD simulation, calculating lift and drag, and determining whether the resulting flow field is numerically and physically valid. What You’ll Work On Solve and validate aerodynamic and fluid-dynamics problems. Translate physical requirements into computational models and solver-ready cases. Create or modify geometries, computational domains, and meshes. Define appropriate initial conditions, boundary conditions, fluid properties, and solver settings. Required Qualifications An MS or PhD in Aerospace Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering with an aerodynamics, fluid dynamics, or thermofluids specialization; or A BS in Aerospace or Mechanical Engineering plus at least 1–2 years of aero-specific professional or research experience. Strong understanding of fluid mechanics and applied aerodynamics. Experience formulating and executing CFD or aerodynamic analyses. Practical proficiency with Python . Experience with at least one engineering tool or library that can be operated through a CLI, scripting interface, configuration files, or programmatic API. Ability to select and justify modeling assumptions, boundary conditions, mesh strategies, and solver settings. Ability to diagnose non-convergence, unstable solutions, incorrect results, and physically invalid outputs. Ability to communicate technical reasoning and engineering trade-offs clearly. Relevant tools may include Python, OpenFOAM, SU2, Gmsh, FEniCSx, Elmer, CalculiX, SciPy , or similar programmatic engineering software. Experience with an equivalent CLI-accessible tool is acceptable. Relevant Python tools may include NumPy, SciPy, pandas, Matplotlib, Jupyter , solver APIs, mesh-processing libraries, or domain-specific scientific packages. No single library is mandatory.
